research_question: Can a source-free, fully 3D Euler vorticity-field receiver, composed of closed finite-core rings/knots, retain additional local kinetic energy through an independently observed post-source-exit interval spanning many receiver clock cycles, while local energy flux and convergence close?
objective: Adversarial falsification: 3D periodic Euler screening with separate controls for conservative energy, pressure, comoving control volume, explicit 0_1/3_1/5_2/6_1 embeddings, and strong non-promotion of short run proxies.
null_hypothesis: H0: no independent qualification of source departure, positive late minimum energy above no-donor control across many cycles and convergent energy-flux closure.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: all preregistered post-exit late-time, core, spatial, time, periodic-box, clock and no-donor controls pass in an independent holdout.
assumptions: Periodic, constant-density incompressible Euler equation in absolute time t; no viscosity/damping/forcing after t0
3D Fourier-Galerkin 2/3-dealiased reference dynamics without imposed geometry symmetry
Initial smooth finite-width vorticity of closed curves, source topology cannot be inferred from a file name
0_1 analytic, 3_1 analytic T(2,3) not an ideal-knot seed, 5_2 and 6_1 require authenticated XYZ
Window moving by passive center marker is translating fixed-shape volume, NOT material volume
Short PREVIEW cannot qualify post-exit energy absorption or intrinsic clocks
The adaptive time-step caps protect finite mesh displacement and vorticity rotation proxy but do not themselves guarantee 3D Euler convergence or physical core fidelity.

steps.operation: Freeze authentic Framework v1.0.10 protocol locally before scientific runs
Run baseline without donor and matched donor run with identical precommitted control-window trajectory
Repeat at half timestep holding the absolute physical final time and geometry fixed
Repeat at finer grid spacing holding the physical core radius and final time fixed
Check periodic box, core profile, source exit by material transport, and independent clock qualification
Execute independent held-out initial conditions and source-qualified knot geometries after locked gates

falsification_criteria: No physical PASS without independently detected source departure and nonzero time separation
No physical PASS unless late window >100 qualified receiver clock cycles with eta_floor statistically positive and greater than error budget
Fail on nonconvergent spatial/temporal/core/box scaling, diverging energy, or unresolved flux
No promotion of a knot label without source hash and independent knot verification
Never infer photon absorption or full ring topology dissolution from local energy transfer
Numerical energy drift is reported as signed per-iteration truncation error, separated from physical moving-volume energy flux. CPU/GPU software parity alone cannot certify long-time capture.
edge_cases: Window receives donor near field before exit
Oscillator peaks not robust or count < 4
Periodic replica interacts with material structure
Knot XYZ missing; no implicit synthetic 5_2/6_1
Numerical reconnection may occur despite inviscid governing PDE
predictions: A valid absorbing regime would maintain positive late minimal excess after source has demonstrably departed
Resonance, if any, should be predictable from independent receiver Floquet modes rather than tuned after capture
A counterexample occurs when any fully converged receiver returns energy or loses late excess

a075_execution_policy.scope: exploratory numerical refinement, no physics status promotion from one run
a075_execution_policy.cpu_compiler: Framework v1.0.10 build_pybind, native OpenMP kernel only
a075_execution_policy.gpu_euler: PyTorch XPU spectral and pressure solver; runtime availability+precision/parity required, no SYCL worker mislabeling
a075_execution_policy.cpu_native_scope: C++ performs full-grid nonlinear cross product; FFT and Leray operator remain SciPy (hybrid, no independent full solver).
a075_execution_policy.gpu_precision_rule: FP32 outputs are screening only; parity against CPU-FP64 and device identity required.
